Turns remaining (including this turn): 5.
Your workspace (write deliverables here, relative paths resolve here): <ESTATE>/ledger/runs/<RUNSTAMP>-fx-happy-row-v2-fx-t1/workspace

tool_schema.description: Read a file or list a directory. Args: {path, offset?, limit?}. On a directory, returns one entry per line (directories end with /). On a file, offset is a 1-indexed line number; limit is a max line count. Output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). When truncated, the observation starts with 'lines 1-N of M — re-read with offset' so the next read is directed, not blind.
tool_schema.name: fs_read

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read.

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed).

path.description: Workspace-relative path, or an absolute path inside the read-only repository snapshot.

tool_schema.description: Write a file, creating parent dirs. Args: {path, content}.
tool_schema.name: fs_write

tool_schema.description: Run a command inside the workspace sandbox. Pass {"cmd":["ls","docs"]} for direct argv, or {"cmd":"cd docs && ls | head"} (also accepts a bare JSON string) for /bin/sh syntax. With argv, use workspace-relative paths or absolute paths inside the workspace or read-only repository view. Parent traversal in argv is denied. Output over 2000 lines or 50KB is clipped and the full output is saved under .cs-out/.
tool_schema.name: exec
